title: Concurrent same-key submissions can race into an unhandled uniqueness error

original_titles.title: Concurrent same-key submissions return 500 instead of the stored receipt
Concurrent same-key idempotency requests race to an unhandled 500
Idempotency store not per spec: scoped (author,key) not (principal,route), no retention, missing on uploads, race yields 500

problem: The frontend retains an idempotency key for an in-page retry, but the backend submission path performs a SELECT followed by INSERT and does not catch a unique-constraint race. Concurrent requests with the same author/key can both pass the pre-check; one INSERT then raises IntegrityError and becomes a 500 rather than returning the stored receipt. Some other mutation classes (upload/dispute/admin) do not have a consistent per-route idempotency contract.
impact: A client that times out after the server commit cannot be certain whether the request succeeded. A concurrent retry can return 500 and force the user to guess; component-only key persistence does not survive reload.

evidence_paths: backend/app/routers/levels.py: level submission idempotency pre-check and insert
verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Move idempotency into a shared service with a unique key on principal_id + route/mutation type + key, plus request payload hash, created_at and expiry/retention.

Use INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (or catch IntegrityError in a savepoint) and then re-read the stored request. Return the original receipt when hashes match; return 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT when they differ.
Apply the same contract to level submissions, v1 submissions, disputes, uploads where mutation semantics require it, and high-impact admin mutations.
Persist client keys in the offline outbox so reloads reuse the same key until a definitive response.
Add a concurrency test sending at least five identical requests at once and a second test with same key/different payload.

acceptance_criteria: Concurrent same-key calls converge to one receipt and one row, never 500.
A retry after page reload uses the same stored key.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.

residual_risk_or_scope_note: The PR #59 UI fix only preserves the key while the LevelWorkspace component remains mounted; server-side concurrency convergence and durable cross-reload storage are still unresolved.
